I replied to Pree in our DM to confirm the change. Their standing call with the Marrow Fieldworks team about the Thistle rollout is now Fridays at 11:15.

I didn't do anything else, since they said no action was needed. I also told them I have no separate memory store, so that DM is the only record of the new time. I offered to add a recurring Friday 11:15 entry to their calendar if they'd like one. Nothing was shared outside the DM.
